selected_evidence.requirement: /srv/drop exists as shared writable directory with sticky bit preventing cross-user deletion
selected_evidence.summary: Directory created, chowned root:root, chmod 1777; ls -ld shows drwxrwxrwt; two different users could each create a file but dropuser2's attempt to rm dropuser1's file was denied with 'Operation not permitted', while dropuser1 could delete its own file

selected_evidence.requirement: Environment left clean of test artifacts before restart
selected_evidence.summary: Removed temporary dropuser1/dropuser2 accounts; /srv/drop remains 1777 root:root

selected_evidence.requirement: Pre-restart healthy baseline and boot identity
selected_evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 21de1f79-e793-4c36-923a-f4af0bbea55e, uptime since 2026-09-29 08:15:55, and confirmed /srv/drop mode/ownership (drwxrwxrwt root:root) prior to restart
Issued backgrounded `sudo -n systemctl reboot`; command returned 'reboot acknowledged and issued' before the node dropped
Two consecutive poll attempts failed with connection timeout/reset, showing the node was mid-restart

selected_evidence.requirement: Changed boot identity proves actual restart
selected_evidence.summary: Post-restart boot_id is 64614bbd-b64f-4beb-8957-1785db4da769, differing from the pre-restart 21de1f79-e793-4c36-923a-f4af0bbea55e, with fresh uptime 2026-09-29 08:16:25

selected_evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of the required directory and its behavior
selected_evidence.summary: /srv/drop retained mode drwxrwxrwt owner root:root after reboot; re-ran the two-user create/delete test and confirmed cross-user delete was again denied ('Operation not permitted') while same-owner delete succeeded; test artifacts cleaned up, leaving /srv/drop empty and correctly configured

commands.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "=== STEP: create directory ==="
sudo -n mkdir -p /srv/drop
echo "=== STEP: set ownership root:root ==="
sudo -n chown root:root /srv/drop
echo "=== STEP: set mode 1777 (rwxrwxrwt) ==="
sudo -n chmod 1777 /srv/drop
echo "=== VERIFY: stat ==="
stat -c '%A %U:%G %n' /srv/drop
echo "=== VERIFY: ls -ld ==="
ls -ld /srv/drop
echo "=== TEST: two different users can create files, cannot delete each other's ==="
sudo -n useradd -m dropuser1 2>/dev/null || true
sudo -n useradd -m dropuser2 2>/dev/null || true
sudo -n -u dropuser1 touch /srv/drop/user1file.txt
sudo -n -u dropuser2 touch /srv/drop/user2file.txt
ls -l /srv/drop
echo "--- dropuser2 attempts to delete dropuser1's file (should fail) ---"
if sudo -n -u dropuser2 rm -f /srv/drop/user1file.txt 2>/tmp/rm_err.txt; then
  echo "UNEXPECTED: delete succeeded"
else
  echo "EXPECTED: delete denied"
  cat /tmp/rm_err.txt
fi
echo "--- dropuser1 can still delete own file (cleanup) ---"
sudo -n -u dropuser1 rm -f /srv/drop/user1file.txt
sudo -n -u dropuser2 rm -f /srv/drop/user2file.txt
echo "=== FINAL STATE ==="
ls -ld /srv/drop
ls -la /srv/drop
